subject.title: fix(line): prevent silent webhook loss after acknowledgment

question: Should LINE preserve its previous attempt-bounded poison-event lane recovery, or intentionally adopt the shared drain's 24-hour minimum dead-letter age?
rationale: Both policies are implementable, but choosing a day-long lane block changes user-visible failure recovery and requires explicit ownership rather than an adapter-level assumption.

options.title: Preserve bounded recovery
options.body: Configure LINE-specific dead-letter timing so a poison event releases its lane after the established attempt limit.

options.title: Adopt the 24-hour policy
options.body: Keep the shared default only with explicit owner acceptance and live proof showing the operational impact is acceptable.

recommendation.title: Preserve bounded recovery
recommendation.body: Configure LINE-specific dead-letter timing so a poison event releases its lane after the established attempt limit.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history connects this person most directly to the shared ingress-drain contract and channel-adoption policy.
